b.summary:
I fixed the issue and verified it on a real dotnet472 prefix, but none of it survives and nothing was committed. At about 20:19, while I was still checking things, something else ran a recursive delete as the user account. It removed /home/sergiu-alexandrescu/Projects/Fork-Linux, including its .git (only root-owned packaging/snap/.craft is left), every worktree under Fork-Linux-wt except leftover root-owned files in appimage-paths and update-tests, and every ~/.cache/fl-* root. That includes my isolated root ~/.cache/fl-ff472 and ~/.cache/fork-linux and ~/.cache/winetricks. Free disk on / went from about 4 GB to 590 GB. My only deletions were my own prefix inside ~/.cache/fl-ff472 and my 110 MB strace file. I stopped my Xvfb :88. Nothing of mine is running.

What WPF 4.7.2 reads (checked on a real prefix: winetricks dotnet472 into a fresh prefix, Release 461814):
- winetricks dotnet472 installs the four Global*.CompositeFont files only under Framework64\v4.0.30319\WPF\Fonts\ and Framework\v4.0.30319\WPF\Fonts\. There is no WPF\GlobalUserInterface.CompositeFont, so rev 1 of the step warned and patched nothing. A 4.8 prefix has both copies.
- strace -f -e trace=openat on 'fork-linux run' with a repository named 字体-шрифт (Cyrillic, Greek, Chinese, Japanese and Korean subjects and branch names): the only composite font Fork opened was C:\windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\WPF\Fonts\GlobalUserInterface.CompositeFont. It opened it on the first character Selawik lacks. Nothing under WPF\ (the 4.8 location) or the 32-bit Framework\ was opened.
- The assemblies agree. 4.7.2's PresentationCore.dll builds the folder from NDP\v4\Client InstallPath + "WPF\Fonts\". 4.8's builds it from InstallPath + "WPF\".

The fix (lost; it needs re-applying):
- src/fork_linux/steps/font_fallback.py:
  - COMPOSITE_FONT_PARTS and COMPOSITE_FONT_WIN became WPF_DIR_PARTS, COMPOSITE_FONT_LOCATIONS (WPF\ and WPF\Fonts\, Framework64 only) and COMPOSITE_FONT_WINS.
  - composite_font() became composite_fonts(), which returns every copy that is a regular file, found case-insensitively and never through a symlink.
  - New composite_font_copies() gives the folders for doctor, e.g. "WPF\Fonts\".
  - New frozen dataclass Patch(path, text, bom, updated). patched_composite_fonts() reads, applies and XML-checks every copy before anything is written. It raises Unpatchable when no copy exists ("WPF's composite font is missing (<both paths> do not exist)") or when any copy is damaged.
  - composite_font_current() is True only when every copy is current.
  - run_fallback writes only the stale copies, through _write() (atomic, keeps BOM and mode).
  - Step rev goes from 1 to 2 so existing installs re-run it.
- doctor.check_font_fallback: the ok line names the patched folders, e.g. "23 scripts mapped in WPF's composite font (WPF\Fonts\; CJK: JP variant first)".
- tests/fixtures/setup_ctx.write_composite_font gained sub="Fonts".
- Tests added: 4.7.2's only copy is patched, both 4.8 copies are patched and only the stale one is rewritten, one damaged copy means a warning and no writes, the lookup handles case, symlinks, directories and both copies, the location constants, rev 2, and doctor's states for WPF\ only, both copies and WPF\Fonts\ only.
- Docs updated: S10 got a new subsection under Finding 7. AGENTS.md (bootstrap list and Text rendering bullet), docs/SECURITY.md and .agents/skills/troubleshoot/SKILL.md were also updated.
verification: Real 4.7.2 prefix: 'fork-linux setup --dotnet dotnet472' finished with exit 0 and no font_fallback warning (the first two attempts failed: the shared disk hit 0 bytes and the dotnet40 installer hung).

doctor (real prefix): prefix.font_fallback ok '23 scripts mapped in WPF's composite font (WPF\Fonts\; CJK: JP variant first)'. The WPF\Fonts\ copy carried 3 marked blocks, one per FamilyMaps section; the 32-bit Framework copy was left alone.

Screenshot after the fix, viewed: Cyrillic and Greek in Noto Sans; Chinese, Japanese and Korean (Korean included), the full-width colon and the branch names feature/привет-мир and fix/日本語 in Noto Sans CJK.

Screenshot with the block stripped, viewed: the Korean row was empty, the Chinese full-width colon was missing and Cyrillic fell back to narrow Tahoma. This confirms the WPF\Fonts\ copy is what 4.7.2 uses.
Stripping the block gave back Microsoft's 4.7.2 file byte for byte: sha256 3ab0675d...6ef6e3, the same as GlobalUserInterface.CompositeFont_amd64 in the installer's netfx_Full.mzz.
Host pytest, full suite: 3754 passed, 44 skipped (Wine-tier and runtime skips). src/fork_linux at 100% line and branch; font_fallback.py and doctor.py checked at 100% on their own.
ruff check: passed (local ruff 0.16.9; the lint image pins 0.17.0 and was not run). no-suppressions-lint: OK.

FL_CI_STAGE=compat FL_CI_CELL=jammy ./scripts/ci-docker.sh: py_compile 214 files OK, 3745 passed, 53 skipped, stage compat OK (rc=0). One docstring-only edit to _write came after this run started; the targeted tests passed again afterwards.
remaining_problems: DATA LOSS (not caused by this agent): around 20:19 something running as the user deleted /home/sergiu-alexandrescu/Projects/Fork-Linux (including .git), almost every worktree under Fork-Linux-wt (only root-owned leftovers remain in appimage-paths and update-tests), and every ~/.cache/fl-* root, ~/.cache/fork-linux and ~/.cache/winetricks. The branch fix/font-fallback-472 and all uncommitted work, screenshots and logs are gone. The repository has to be restored first, e.g. by cloning it again; whether a remote copy exists is unknown.
Nothing was committed: the deletion happened during final verification, before the commit step.

To redo it: re-apply the font_fallback.py, doctor.py, test, fixture and docs changes from the summary on top of fix/integration, then rerun host pytest, ruff, the no-suppressions lint and the jammy compat cell. The real-Wine evidence above can be cited, but re-running it needs a new dotnet472 prefix, about 3 GB of disk and the queued shared lock.

Design choice to confirm: a damaged copy in either folder turns the whole step into a warning with no writes, even a WPF\Fonts\ copy that .NET 4.8 never reads. It is documented that way and matches the existing 'damaged .NET' handling.

At about 20:19 most of the home directory /home/sergiu-alexandrescu was deleted, not just the project. Every other folder under ~/Projects was also modified at 20:19. ~/.cache/fl-deps-ci-review/src/fork_linux holds only two .pyc files. I found no surviving copy of the repository in /tmp or /var/tmp; /tmp/rl, /tmp/scope and /tmp/lsv are unrelated scratch repos. I can't fetch a remote either: gh is not logged in and no git config survives. So the worktree /home/sergiu-alexandrescu/Projects/Fork-Linux-wt/font-fallback-472, the branch fix/font-fallback-472 and the base branch fix/integration can't be created, and none of the requested checks could be run: no regression on the 4.8 path, upgrade from an already-patched 4.8 prefix, a prefix with both files, permissions and BOM, doctor matching reality. The builder's fix exists only as the description in its report and was never committed, so there is no code to judge. Verdict: NOT VERIFIED / BLOCKED. Leave the issue open. I deliberately did not try undelete or disk forensics, rebuild the repo from memory, or touch the processes still running.

The builder's strace finding (4.7.2 opens only Framework64\v4.0.30319\WPF\Fonts\GlobalUserInterface.CompositeFont; 4.8 reads WPF\) and its design (patch every existing copy, writing only stale ones atomically and keeping BOM and mode; rev 1 to 2; doctor names the patched folders) are a sound plan to re-apply once the repo is restored, but I could not independently check them.
